title: EPF ka byaaj FD se zyada? Safe options ki tulna.
tag: PF GURU JI #04 · EPF VS FD

brief.topic: EPF ka byaaj FD, post office, PPF aur LIC se zyada kyun? Safe options ki seedhi tulna.

repeat_check.different_because: ep02 explains what PF is and how it's cut from the salary; this reel compares EPF's interest with the safe options savers pick (bank FD, PPF, post office NSC, LIC), adds the tax, and says why not to withdraw it early.

brief.viewer: A salaried person who keeps savings in FDs, the post office or an LIC policy, and is thinking of taking their PF out after changing jobs.
brief.hook: PF nikaal ke FD karne ki soch rahe ho? Ruko!
brief.problem: People take their PF out and put it in an FD: safe, but on every ₹1,00,000 they lose about ₹1,850 of interest a year.
why: EPF's 2025-26 rate is higher than SBI's best FD rate, PPF's and NSC's this quarter
An LIC endowment policy has no fixed interest rate: its return comes from bonuses
EPF interest is tax-free on up to ₹2,50,000 of one's own contribution a year; FD interest is taxed
steps: See what the difference means on one sum (an example ₹1,00,000 for a year, simple interest)
On changing jobs, transfer the PF instead of withdrawing it
Know how EPF interest builds up: on the monthly balance, credited at the year's end
brief.check: EPF's rate is fixed every year (8.25% is 2025-26's), and the post office's 8.2% is only for senior citizens and girls.
brief.help: The member's passbook on the member portal shows the interest credited.
brief.share_target: A friend about to take out their PF and put it in an FD
brief.why_now: Small savings rates for October–December 2026 were just kept unchanged, and the 2025-26 EPF interest is in passbooks.

data.label: EPF interest rate for 2025-26
data.source: PIB, Ministry of Labour and Employment, 2 March 2026: 239th meeting of the CBT, EPF
data.check_note: Quote: 'CBT recommended 8.25 % annual rate of interest to be credited on EPF accumulations in members' accounts for the financial year 2025-26.' 2024-25 was 8.25% too (PIB 28 Feb 2025). The government's notification and the credit (reported as EPFO's circular of 1 July 2026, credited by 15 July) weren't on an official page the research could open: check epfo.gov.in → Circulars, or your own passbook.
data.check_result: Seen on PIB PRID 2234502, 2 Mar 2026: CBT recommended 8.25% for FY 2025-26; EPFO circular 1 Jul 2026 notified it.

data.label: A year's interest on the example sum in the FD (simple)
A year's interest on the example sum in EPF (simple)
How much more EPF gives than the FD on the example sum in a year
Yearly own contribution on which EPF interest stays tax-free (with an employer)
data.source: Income-tax Act, 2025 (in force 1 April 2026), Schedule II, entry 4
data.check_note: p. 500: interest 'shall not be eligible for exclusion from total income where ... it is attributable to contribution ... made by that person on or after the 1st April, 2021; and such contribution exceeds ... ₹ 5,00,000 in a financial year in such fund where no contribution is made by the employer ... or ₹ 2,50,000 in other cases'. So with an employer paying in, interest is tax-free on up to ₹2,50,000 of the member's own contribution a year.
data.check_result: Seen in Income-tax Act 2025, Schedule II entry 4 (p. 500), 14 Nov 2026: Rs 2,50,000 with employer, Rs 5,00,000 without.

data.label: An LIC endowment policy has no fixed interest rate
data.statement: An LIC endowment policy pays the sum assured plus bonuses that LIC declares each year from its experience; it has no fixed interest rate.
data.source: LIC's New Endowment Plan (Plan 714, UIN 512N277V03), sales brochure, from 22 September 2025
data.check_note: Brochure p. 3: at maturity, 'Sum Assured on Maturity along with vested Simple Reversionary Bonuses and Final Additional Bonus, if any'; p. 4: bonuses are 'declared as per the experience of the Corporation' each year; p. 22: 'Some benefits are guaranteed and some benefits are variable with returns based on the future performance of your insurer'. A bonus is guaranteed once declared; future bonuses aren't.
data.check_result: Seen in LIC New Endowment Plan 714 brochure, 14 Nov 2026: bonuses declared as per the Corporation's experience; no fixed rate.

data.label: How EPF interest is worked out and credited
data.statement: EPF interest is fixed every year by the Central Government with the CBT, worked out on the monthly running balance and credited at the end of the year.
data.source: EPF Scheme, 2026, paragraph 42 (Gazette of India, G.S.R. 525(E), 29 June 2026)
data.check_note: pp. 84–85: 'The Commissioner shall credit to the account of each member interest at such rate as may be determined by the Central Government in consultation with the Central Board ... interest shall be credited to the member's account on monthly running balance basis with effect from the last day in each year'. (The correction notice of 4 August 2026 changes only 42(3).)
data.check_result: Seen in EPF Scheme 2026 para 42 (G.S.R. 525(E)) via verbatim gazette reproduction, 14 Nov 2026: monthly running balance, credited at year-end; gazette PDF itself unreachable.

data.label: EPF interest is tax-free; FD interest is taxed
data.statement: EPF interest is tax-free, except on a member's own contribution above ₹2,50,000 a year (₹5,00,000 with no employer contribution); bank FD interest is taxed as income from other sources.
data.source: Income-tax Act, 2025, Schedule II, entry 4 (EPF interest) and section 92 (income from other sources)
data.check_note: Schedule II, entry 4 (p. 500): the accumulated balance in a recognised provident fund, EPF included (section 2(91), p. 19), is excluded from total income, with the interest limit above. Section 92 (p. 137): 'Income of every kind which is not to be excluded from the total income ... shall be chargeable to income-tax under the head Income from other sources', which is where bank FD interest falls. The Finance Act, 2026 didn't change these.
data.check_result: Seen in Income-tax Act 2025, Schedule II entry 4 (p. 500) and section 92 (p. 137), 14 Nov 2026.

data.label: On a new job, move the PF, don't withdraw it
data.statement: On changing jobs, a member can move the old PF account to the new one (Form 13), so the money keeps earning EPF interest.
data.source: EPFO, 'Which claim form' (Form 13: moving an old PF account to the new one); brand/epfo-forms.json
data.check_note: Form 13 moves the PF from an old employer's account to the new one, so it keeps earning EPF interest; the forms list (brand/epfo-forms.json) has it, checked on 13 November 2026.
data.check_result: Seen on EPFO WhichClaimForm page, 14 Nov 2026: Form 13 for transfer of account.

data.label: The passbook shows the interest
data.statement: The member's passbook on the member portal shows the contributions, the interest and the balance.
data.source: PIB, Ministry of Labour and Employment, 18 September 2025: Passbook Lite on the member portal
data.check_note: PIB: 'Passbook Lite' in the member portal gives a 'summarised view of the contributions, withdrawals and balance'. Open your own passbook to see the interest line for 2025-26.
data.check_result: Seen on PIB PRID 2168059, 18 Sep 2025: Passbook Lite on the member portal shows contributions, withdrawals and balance.

data.label: Who the 8.2% schemes are for
data.statement: The post office's 8.2% schemes are the Senior Citizens' Savings Scheme (people aged 60 or more) and Sukanya Samriddhi (an account for a girl child).
data.source: India Post, savings schemes (Senior Citizens' Savings Scheme; Sukanya Samriddhi Account)
data.check_note: Check who can open each: SCSS is for people aged 60 or more (and some retirees from 55); Sukanya Samriddhi is an account for a girl child under 10, opened by a parent or guardian. The research quoted only the rates, not these rules: open the scheme pages.
data.check_result: Seen on government/PSU scheme pages, 14 Nov 2026: SCSS 60+ (retirees 55+), Sukanya for a girl child under 10.

post.caption:
PF nikaal ke FD karne ki soch rahe ho? Ruko!

Har ₹1,00,000 pe, har saal ₹1,850 ka nuksaan. Dekho: SBI FD (2-3 saal, sabse zyada wala) 6.4%. PPF 7.1%. Post office NSC 7.7%. LIC policy: fixed byaaj nahi, bonus pe chalta hai. EPF: 8.25%. Upar se EPF ka byaaj tax-free (₹2,50,000 saalana contribution tak), FD ka taxable.

Yaad rakho: EPF rate har saal tay hota hai (8.25% pichhle saal ka), aur post office ka 8.2% sirf senior citizens aur betiyon (Sukanya) ke liye hai. FD aur post office ke rate badalte rehte hain: invest karne se pehle bank aur India Post pe dekho.

Naukri badli? PF transfer karo, nikaalo mat. Apna byaaj member portal ki passbook mein dekho.

Yeh us dost ko bhejo jo PF nikaalne wala hai.

EPFO ki har jankari chahiye? Follow karo @pfguruji.

PF Guru Ji EPFO ka official channel nahi hai. Niyam: epfo.gov.in
